item.title: About
item.description:
Hi, I’m Jamie Rowe — a researcher, not a lawyer.

This site exists because divorce information online is either written by lawyers for lawyers, or buried in intimidating government pages. Every guide here is built by reading official state court sources — statutes, court websites, published fee schedules — and translating them into plain English, with the verification date noted so you know how current the information is.

What this site is: a map — costs, steps, timelines, and the questions you’ll want to ask a licensed attorney in your state.

item.title: Contact

item.title: Disclaimer
item.description:
The information on this website is for general informational purposes only. It is not legal advice, and reading it does not create any attorney-client relationship. I am not a lawyer.

Divorce laws, fees, and procedures vary by state and county and change over time. While every article is checked against official sources (state court websites and statutes) on the date noted, you must verify current details with your local court or a licensed attorney before acting.

item.title: Free Resources
item.description:

Who we are

Divorce Roadmap is an informational website providing plain-English guides about the divorce process. For any privacy questions or requests, contact: [Jamie.Rowe.writes@proton.me]

Information we collect
